name: month-only
note: 46 points 16 h apart (dt = 2/3 day), allTime null: the series is the month alone; flag no-alltime.

name: constant-growth
note: 11 daily points, av_i = 5^i * 4^(10-i): r = 0.25 exactly in every interval, so sd == 0 and dd == 0 exactly (Sharpe and Sortino "+inf"), maxDrawdown 0 (Calmar "+inf", no-drawdown).

name: flat-zero-pnl
note: 31 daily points, constant account value and PnL 0: mu = sd = dd = 0, periodReturn = maxDrawdown = 0, so Sharpe, Sortino and Calmar are null (0/0) and consistency is null (S_yy == 0).

name: downtrend
note: Loses about 1% a day (sd 0.3%) for 30 days: slope b < 0 so consistency = 0; Sortino is negative.

name: deposit-withdrawal
note: Interval 10 (ending BASE-20d) has a 25,000 deposit: capital = start + deposit. Interval 20 (ending BASE-10d) has a 30,000 withdrawal: capital = start equity (flow < 0 is ignored). No flag.

name: dust-interval
note: The account sits at about 100 USD (< 1% of the series peak) at the start of intervals 13 and 14: they are skipped (dust-equity), skippedTimeShare = 2/30. Interval 15 starts at dust but its deposit counts as capital, so it is used.

name: no-intervals
note: Account value 0 throughout: every interval has capital <= 0 and is skipped; no-intervals, the ratios and returns are null, coveredDays 0, skippedTimeShare 1.

name: alltime-no-intervals
note: A valid allTime whose only interval has zero capital: allTimeMaxDrawdown is null (no data), not 0. allTime does not end with month, so the series is month alone (stitch-mismatch).

name: ruin
note: Interval 20 loses the whole equity (r = -1): ruin, the curve is 0 from then on although the account is refunded and trades again; periodReturn = annualisedReturn = -1, maxDrawdown 1, consistency null.

name: stitched-grid-drawdown
note: allTime has daily points (a young account) and month daily points; the account dropped 20% in the day ending BASE-61d and recovered the next day. That dip is in the coarse part between grid points ts_0 + 28d and ts_0 + 35d (ts_0 = BASE-90d), so the 7-day drawdown grid does not see it: maxDrawdown is about 0.0162, versus about 0.2120 if every curve point were used.

name: short-history
note: allTime starts at BASE-57d with value 0; the first point with value > 0 is BASE-50d (activeStart). activeStart > E - 90d: short-history, the series starts at activeStart, lookbackDays = 50.

name: coarse-history
note: An old account: allTime points every 14 days, so coarse intervals are longer than 1.5 * 7 days: coarse-history.

name: stitch-mismatch-end
note: allTime ends at the same timestamp as month but its last account value is 5 USD higher: stitch-mismatch, allTime is not used for the series (month alone, own PnL baseline) but still gives allTimeMaxDrawdown and activeStart.

name: stitch-mismatch-shared
note: allTime and month end together and agree at the end, but at the shared timestamp 1787875200000 allTime's PnL is 0.50 USD off pnl': stitch-mismatch.

name: history-valid
note: allTime weekly from BASE-150d, history daily from BASE-75d to BASE-31d (agreeing with allTime at shared timestamps, no offset), month daily from BASE-30d. Series: allTime points BASE-87d and BASE-80d (coarse), then history and month (fine); fineTimeShare = 75/87.

name: history-mismatch
note: As history-valid, but history's PnL at the timestamp 1783728000000 (shared with allTime) is 1 USD off: history is dropped (history-mismatch) and the series is allTime (coarse) + month.

name: history-without-alltime
note: Same history as history-valid but allTime is null: no-alltime, history is dropped without a history-mismatch flag (its baseline cannot be joined); the series is month alone.

name: invalid-month-unequal
note: month has 31 account-value points and 30 PnL points: invalid, metrics null.

name: month-null
note: month is null: metrics null.

name: alltime-drawdown-older
note: A 45% loss 199 days before the end, outside the 90-day lookback: allTimeMaxDrawdown (whole allTime window, weekly points) is at least 0.45 while maxDrawdown over the lookback is small.

name: low-coverage
note: 7 of 30 daily intervals start at dust (skippedTimeShare = 7/30 > 0.20): dust-equity and low-coverage (the metrics are still computed from the used intervals).

name: config-lookback-45
note: Path at 8 h steps, month at 16 h, allTime daily; config lookbackDays 45 and coarseGridDays 5 (drawdown grid every 5 days in the coarse part), dustEquityFraction 0.05.

name: realistic-16h-weekly
note: Path at 8 h steps for 200 days; month every 16 h (46 points), allTime every 7 days. Stitched without flags; coarse part on the 7-day grid, month part every point.
